# CLI full reference

Auto-generated from `brewslm --help`. For curated examples and the trio (UI / CLI / API) format see [CLI reference](cli.md).

## `brewslm`

```text
usage: brewslm [-h] [--api-base API_BASE] [--token TOKEN] [--timeout-seconds TIMEOUT_SECONDS]
               {project,dataset,adapter,models,ingest,preflight,train,repro,manifest,pipeline,export,doctor,optimize,autopilot,deploy,logs,support-bundle,scaffold,extensions,eval}
               ...

BrewSLM command line client

positional arguments:
  {project,dataset,adapter,models,ingest,preflight,train,repro,manifest,pipeline,export,doctor,optimize,autopilot,deploy,logs,support-bundle,scaffold,extensions,eval}
    project             Manage project settings (budget, etc)
    dataset             Dataset upload/import helpers
    adapter             Dataset Adapter Studio workflows
    models              Universal base model registry and compatibility commands
    ingest              Import remote dataset (HF/Kaggle/URL)
    preflight           Run training preflight for project config
    train               Launch / manage training runs (start, rerun, clone, pause, resume, checkpoints)
    repro               Reproducibility helpers (manifest dump).
    manifest            brewslm.yaml export / validate / diff / apply helpers (P23).
    pipeline            End-to-end pipeline helpers (P23).
    export              Create and run an export job
    doctor              Check project readiness (GPU/deps/secrets). Use --deep for P31/P32/P33 observability roll-up.
    optimize            Rank export candidates with measured vs estimated metrics
    autopilot           Autopilot plan/run/repair/rollback/decisions commands.
    deploy              Deployment surfaces: plan, smoke-test, execute, promote/reject/rollback, telemetry, drift,
                        score (P29).
    logs                Tail the canonical RunEvent log (P31/P35).
    support-bundle      Generate / list / download support bundles (P34).
    scaffold            Generate a contract-valid plugin scaffold (P38).
    extensions          List / validate / reload extension plugins (P37).
    eval                Evaluation workflows: pack generation, gold-set ops, label, run, compare, clusters,
                        remediation.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --api-base API_BASE   API base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api)
  --token TOKEN         API token (or set BREWSLM_TOKEN)
  --timeout-seconds TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        HTTP request timeout in seconds (default: 60.0)
```

## `brewslm project`  {#cmd-project}

```text
usage: brewslm project [-h] {budget,create,bootstrap,blueprint,budget-set} ...

positional arguments:

    create              Create a project (quickstart template supported)
    bootstrap           Analyze a plain-English brief and bootstrap a Domain Blueprint workflow.
    blueprint           Inspect project Domain Blueprint revisions.
    budget-set          Update project budget policy

options:
```


### `brewslm project create`  {#cmd-project-create}

```text
usage: brewslm project create [-h] --name NAME [--template TEMPLATE] [--no-template] [--description DESCRIPTION]
                              [--base-model BASE_MODEL_NAME] [--domain-pack-id DOMAIN_PACK_ID]
                              [--domain-profile-id DOMAIN_PROFILE_ID] [--target-profile-id TARGET_PROFILE_ID]
                              [--gate-policy GATE_POLICY] [--budget-settings BUDGET_SETTINGS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --name NAME           Project name
  --template TEMPLATE   Template alias (general, support, legal) or path to template JSON
  --no-template         Skip template loading and use only explicit CLI fields.
  --description DESCRIPTION
                        Project description override
  --base-model BASE_MODEL_NAME
                        Base model name override
  --domain-pack-id DOMAIN_PACK_ID
  --domain-profile-id DOMAIN_PROFILE_ID
  --target-profile-id TARGET_PROFILE_ID
                        Target profile id (default from API)
  --gate-policy GATE_POLICY
                        Inline JSON object overriding gate policy
  --budget-settings BUDGET_SETTINGS
                        Inline JSON object overriding budget settings
```

### `brewslm project bootstrap`  {#cmd-project-bootstrap}

```text
usage: brewslm project bootstrap [-h] [--name NAME] [--description DESCRIPTION] [--base-model BASE_MODEL]
                                 [--project PROJECT_ID] [--brief BRIEF] [--brief-file BRIEF_FILE]
                                 [--sample-input SAMPLE_INPUT] [--sample-output SAMPLE_OUTPUT]
                                 [--sample-inputs-file SAMPLE_INPUTS_FILE] [--sample-outputs-file SAMPLE_OUTPUTS_FILE]
                                 [--risk-note RISK_NOTE] [--target TARGET] [--target-profile-id TARGET_PROFILE_ID]
                                 [--create-project] [--apply] [--no-llm-enrich]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --name NAME           Project name (optional with --create-project)
  --description DESCRIPTION
                        Project description override
  --base-model BASE_MODEL
                        Optional base model override for project creation
  --project PROJECT_ID, --project-id PROJECT_ID
  --brief BRIEF         Plain-English brief text
  --brief-file BRIEF_FILE
                        Path to plain-text brief file
  --sample-input SAMPLE_INPUT
                        Representative sample input (repeatable)
  --sample-output SAMPLE_OUTPUT
                        Representative sample output (repeatable)
  --sample-inputs-file SAMPLE_INPUTS_FILE
                        Path to newline-delimited sample inputs
  --sample-outputs-file SAMPLE_OUTPUTS_FILE
                        Path to newline-delimited sample outputs
  --risk-note RISK_NOTE
                        Safety/compliance note (repeatable)
  --target TARGET       Deployment target hint for blueprint analysis (for example edge_gpu, mobile_cpu, vllm_server).
  --target-profile-id TARGET_PROFILE_ID
                        Project target profile id when using --create-project.
  --create-project      Create a new project from analyzed blueprint
  --apply               Apply saved blueprint when targeting existing project
  --no-llm-enrich       Force deterministic-only analysis path
```

## `brewslm train`  {#cmd-train}

```text
usage: brewslm train [-h] {start,rerun,clone,pause,resume,checkpoints} ...

positional arguments:
  {start,rerun,clone,pause,resume,checkpoints}
    start               Launch training (autopilot one-click)
    rerun               Create a new experiment whose config is a parent run's manifest verbatim (P15).
    clone               Create a new experiment from a parent run's manifest with shallow config overrides (P15).
    pause               Request the runtime pause this run on its next polling iteration (P17).
    resume              Re-dispatch a PAUSED run from its latest checkpoint (P17).
    checkpoints         List a run's checkpoints, or promote / fork-resume from a specific step (P16).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `brewslm train start`  {#cmd-train-start}

```text
usage: brewslm train start [-h] --project PROJECT_ID [--autopilot] [--one-click] [--intent INTENT]
```

```text
usage: brewslm deploy [-h]
```

```text
  --no-write            Return the file contents in the response without writing to disk.
```

## `brewslm extensions`  {#cmd-extensions}

```text
usage: brewslm extensions [-h] {list,validate,reload} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,validate,reload}
    list                List configured plugin kinds and their loaded modules.
    validate            Validate a plugin module against its kind contract (does not register).
    reload              Reload extension modules configured in settings.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `brewslm extensions list`  {#cmd-extensions-list}

```text
usage: brewslm extensions list [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

### `brewslm extensions validate`  {#cmd-extensions-validate}

```text
usage: brewslm extensions validate [-h] --kind KIND --module MODULE [--force-reload]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --kind KIND      Plugin kind (adapter / runtime / domain-pack / eval-pack).
  --module MODULE  Importable Python module path of the plugin.
  --force-reload   Reload the module if already imported.
```

### `brewslm extensions reload`  {#cmd-extensions-reload}

```text
usage: brewslm extensions reload [-h] [--kind KIND]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --kind KIND  Reload a single kind. Omit to reload every kind that supports it.
```

## `brewslm eval`  {#cmd-eval}

```text
usage: brewslm eval [-h] {generate,gold-set,label,run,compare,clusters,remediate} ...

positional arguments:
  {generate,gold-set,label,run,compare,clusters,remediate}
    generate            Auto-generate an evaluation pack from blueprint + dataset + adapter (P9).
    gold-set            Gold-set create / add-row / submit (lock draft version).
    label               PATCH a gold-set row (P10).
    run                 Run held-out evaluation for an experiment.
    compare             Diff the latest metrics of two experiments (by eval_type).
    clusters            Fetch failure clusters for an eval result (P12).
    remediate           Generate a closed-loop remediation plan for an experiment's failures.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `brewslm eval generate`  {#cmd-eval-generate}

```text
usage: brewslm eval generate [-h] --project PROJECT_ID [--blueprint-id BLUEPRINT_ID] [--dataset-id DATASET_ID]
                             [--adapter-id ADAPTER_ID] [--no-judge-rubric] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT_ID, --project-id PROJECT_ID
  --blueprint-id BLUEPRINT_ID
  --dataset-id DATASET_ID
  --adapter-id ADAPTER_ID
  --no-judge-rubric     Omit the LLM-judge rubric from the generated pack.
  --json                Emit raw JSON (always on for this subcommand).
```

### `brewslm eval gold-set`  {#cmd-eval-gold-set}

```text
usage: brewslm eval gold-set [-h] {create,add-row,submit} ...

positional arguments:
  {create,add-row,submit}
    create              Seed a gold dataset (lazy-creates if missing) and report its id.
    add-row             Add row(s) — via P10 sampling from a source dataset OR a legacy Q/A pair.
    submit              Lock the current draft version (gold-set-id is the dataset id).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `brewslm eval label`  {#cmd-eval-label}

```text
usage: brewslm eval label [-h] --gold-set-id GOLD_SET_ID --row-id ROW_ID [--expected-json EXPECTED_JSON]
                          [--labels-json LABELS_JSON] [--rationale RATIONALE]
                          [--status {pending,in_review,approved,rejected,changes_requested}]
                          [--reviewer-id REVIEWER_ID] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --gold-set-id GOLD_SET_ID
  --row-id ROW_ID
  --expected-json EXPECTED_JSON
                        JSON object literal, e.g. '{"answer":"…"}'.
  --labels-json LABELS_JSON
                        JSON object literal, e.g. '{"difficulty":"hard"}'.
  --rationale RATIONALE
                        Free-text rationale for the answer.
  --status {pending,in_review,approved,rejected,changes_requested}
  --reviewer-id REVIEWER_ID
                        Assign a reviewer. Pass -1 to clear the assignment.
  --json
```
